name: Salt
summary: Sodium chloride in bags and blocks: table salt, water softener salt, road salt and pool salt.
uses: Oral rehydration drinks (with clean water and sugar)
identify: Groceries and restaurants (table salt), hardware stores and homes with water softeners (20–25 kg bags of pellets), road depots (big piles of rock salt), pool shops and farm stores (salt blocks). Road salt often has grit and anti-caking chemicals; softener and pool salt are usually nearly pure but not sold as food grade.
test: Read the bag for sodium chloride and any additives; some softener salt is potassium chloride instead. Food salt is white and dissolves clear; road salt leaves grit.
